title: USPS SOLICITATION - EEO - EXPERIENCED REDRESS MEDIATORS - MAY 2026
description_text: Conduct mediations utilizing both the transformative and facilitative mediation styles and facilitate settlement agreements for the United States Postal Service’s ADR Program (EEO) Resolve Employment Disputes Reach Equitable Solutions Swiftly (REDRESS) and Employee Labor Relations Manual (ELM) 650 mediations.
